kapak.alt: Telling the type of loss in a baby

youtube.baslik: How is the type of hearing loss told apart in a baby? #shorts
youtube.aciklama: To tell the type of loss in a baby, the middle ear and bone conduction are assessed together. In the example case, a 1000 Hz probe tone gave positive peaked tympanograms in both ears, while on bone conduction ABR there was no response even at the highest level the bone vibrator could deliver. Together with a normal 1000 Hz tympanogram, this finding supports a sensorineural loss; the findings are consistent with a bilateral moderate sensorineural loss, and the physician leads diagnosis and the search for the cause.
